intro_html: Creamy Tuscan chicken with sun-dried tomatoes tastes like a restaurant special, but the slow cooker makes it a weeknight regular. This bowl brings 67 grams of protein for about $4.25 a serving (at everyday cost), tossed with penne in a rich, tangy sauce. Fourteen servings from one pot turns a fancy-feeling dinner into an affordable weekly habit.
cost_closing_html: About $4.25 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: You get 67 grams of protein and 577 calories per serving, restaurant flavor at a home-cook price.
upsell_html: Tastes like a splurge, costs like a staple. That's the sweet spot we're always chasing. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Sun-dried tomatoes are the priciest item here, so buy the bag, not the oil-packed jar, and a little rehydrates into big flavor.
Canned coconut milk stands in for heavy cream at a fraction of the price, so keep a can or two in the pantry.
Parmesan brings the salty depth, so buy a wedge or shaker and use it sparingly across this and other pasta nights.
make_it: Add the chicken, chopped sun-dried tomatoes, coconut milk, and chicken broth to the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 7 hours until the chicken is tender and the sauce is fragrant.
Shred the chicken and stir in the parmesan and a drizzle of olive oil until the sauce turns creamy.
Boil the penne separately until just al dente and drain it.
Toss the pasta with the creamy Tuscan sauce, or spoon the sauce over each serving of pasta.
